messages:
matt: heads up — PR #4826 touches auth-proxy + vault paths. planning to merge in the 16:00 PT slot unless sec flags. need quick eyes on secrets scope + vpc egress rule. details:

```
- SA: inference-edge-sa -> reduced scope
- Vault path: secret/data/onprem/* -> will add read-only for SA
- K8s NetworkPolicy: allow egress to 10.4.0.0/16
```

ping @jess @olivia @tanvi

jess: can you paste the exact vault policy diff? quick grep would help, i can't pull the branch right now.

matt: pasted the policy (redacted) below — role binds sa and ttl set to 1h:

```
path "secret/data/onprem/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}

# vault role mapping (kubernetes auth)
role \"inference-edge-role\" {
  bound_service_account_names = [\"inference-edge-sa\"]
  token_ttl = \"1h\"
}
```

olivia: need to ensure token TTL is enforced by CI/e2e. where's the TTL asserted? also why 10.4.0.0/16 egress — feels broad for onprem backup IPs.

matt: TTL asserted in the vault role file under `deploy/vault/roles/*.hcl` (i'll add a unit that checks it). 10.4/16 is current ops range for storage cluster; i can tighten to 10.4.12.0/24 if that reduces blast radius.

pr-bot: PR #4826 — CI: ✅  unit/e2e passed, lint ✅, security-scan: 2 findings (see comments)

sec-bot: automated-security-check: vault policy uses read-only (OK). token ttl <= 1h (OK). flagged: networkpolicy egress to 10.4.0.0/16 classified as MEDIUM (recommend restrict to single /24 or explicit IPs). no cleartext secrets detected.

tanvi: i can give conditional approval once: (1) CIDR narrowed to /24 or specific IPs, (2) add a quick smoke test verifying egress destination, (3) PR description documents rotation/rollback plan. please add the test under `tests/smoke/egress_check.sh` that calls curl to the target IP and verifies conn allowed only to that range.

matt: thanks — will push change in ~10m. adding smoke test + a YAML check that asserts `token_ttl: 1h` present. i'll also note rotation steps in PR description.

jess: :thumbsup: i'll do a final scan after the CIDR change and smoke test. if clean i'll mark LGTM.

pr-bot: merge-window reminder — scheduled slot 16:00 PT. add label `ready-to-merge` when done and i'll auto-merge at slot if no blocking comments.

matt: will update and ping here once pushed. thanks everyone.

(30m later)
matt: pushed: narrowed egress to 10.4.12.0/24, added smoke test, CI passed again. label applied. cc @jess @tanvi

jess: quick look — LGTM from secrets side. left one tiny nit about comment formatting.

tanvi: approving now. thanks for the quick turnaround.

pr-bot: merged PR #4826 into main at 6472512500. deploy pipeline started.

sec-bot: post-merge check: sampling vault audit logs for events from inference-edge-sa — looks clean so far. no anomalous token usage detected in the last 30m.

matt: closing loop — will monitor metrics and share a follow-up if anything odd shows. appreciate the fast reviews!
